title: Registrar: Changes to Major/Minor
pageTitle: Office of the University Registrar (OUR) - Declaration & Change of Degree, Major or Minor

sections.heading: Declaration & Change of Degree, Major or Minor > Undergraduate Students
sections.text:
Students may petition to change or declare additional Majors, Minors, and Academic Options (Track, Concentration, Specialization, etc.) after completing their first quarter at UC Davis. If you are interested in declaring an additional program of study, please complete the OASIS Change of Program Petition. The Change of Program Petition allows you to request changes to your:
Degree Objective
Major
Academic Option; Track, Concentration, Specialization, etc.
Minor
Students may submit one Change of Program Petition at a time. Petitions should be submitted before applying to graduate.

sections.heading: Declaration & Change of Degree, Major or Minor > Undergraduate Students > Change of Major Within a College
sections.text: Students planning to change from one major to another major within the same college must be approved by an advisor of the major they are leaving, endorsed by an advisor of the new proposed major, and requires the dean's office for approval.

sections.heading: Declaration & Change of Degree, Major or Minor > Undergraduate Students > Change of Major Accompanied by Change of College
sections.text: Students planning to change to a major outside their college requires approval by an adviser of the new proposed major and requires dean's approval for admission to the new college. Additional steps may be required by their advisor.

sections.heading: Declaration & Change of Degree, Major or Minor > Undergraduate Students > Declaring Multiple Majors Within a College
sections.text: To declare additional major(s) within the same college requires approval of the adviser of the majors involved and the Dean's office. You need consent of the department or committee in charge of your previous major, the consent of the department or committee in charge of your proposed new major and the approval of the dean of your college. A single degree is granted and one diploma is issued to students who graduate with multiple majors within the same college.

sections.heading: Declaration & Change of Degree, Major or Minor > Undergraduate Students > Declaring Multiple Majors Within a College > College of Biological Sciences or the College of Letters & Science Students
sections.text: A student who completes all requirements for approved multiple majors in which one major normally leads to a Bachelor of Arts degree and another normally leads to a Bachelor of Science degree, will receive a Bachelor of Arts & Science degree.

sections.heading: Declaration & Change of Degree, Major or Minor > Undergraduate Students > Declaring Multiple Majors Between Colleges
sections.text: To declare an additional major outside of your current college, submit a Change of Major form. Admission into multiple majors is subject to the approval of departments in charge of the majors involved and the dean's offices involved. You need the consent of the department or committee in charge of your major, the consent of the department or committee in charge of your proposed additional major and the approval of the dean of your current college as well as the endorsement of the dean of your additional college.

sections.heading: Declaration & Change of Degree, Major or Minor > Undergraduate Students > Declaring an Individual Major
sections.text: Students with academic interests not accommodated by an established major have the opportunity to design an individual major. If you wish to undertake an individual major, request the appropriate forms from your dean’s office. Individual major program requirements are outlined in the General Catalog.

sections.heading: Declaration & Change of Degree, Major or Minor > Undergraduate Students > Declaring a Minor
sections.text: If you are interested in two or more areas of study, you should consider completing one or more minor programs. You will find a complete list of the minors offered at UC Davis under Minor Programs in the General Catalog. If you want to declare or update your minor(s), complete the OASIS Change of Program Petition.

sections.heading: Declaration & Change of Degree, Major or Minor > Undergraduate Students > Declaring a Minor > School of Education
sections.text: The Education minor offered by the School of Education requires approval by the School of Education and your dean's office. For more information about the education minor, see the Minor in Education or contact the School of Education.

sections.heading: Declaration & Change of Degree, Major or Minor > Undergraduate Students > More on Declaring a Major, Double Major, or Minor
sections.text:
For more information, contact the appropriate dean’s office:
College of Agricultural & Environmental Sciences
College of Biological Sciences
College of Engineering
College of Letters & Science
Graduate School of Management

sections.heading: Declaration & Change of Degree, Major or Minor > Graduate & Professional Students > Graduate Students
sections.text:
Graduate students must complete a Petition for Change of Graduate Major, Degree Objective, Multiple Graduate Majors, or Multiple Degree Objectives (GS301) form and secure the required approvals.
Before you petition, seek the advice of the Senior Academic Advisor for your program and also the Graduate Adviser(s) for the program(s) involved. For more information regarding a change of graduate major, degree objective, or double major declaration, contact Graduate Studies.
